name: Physics-based Pseudo Label Generation
definition: A pipeline to generate high-fidelity pseudo reflectance and shading labels from a trained multi-light NeRF model to guide intrinsic decomposition training in Stage 2.
summary: Physics-based Pseudo Label Generation creates high-fidelity pseudo reflectance and shading labels from a trained NeRF using explicit geometric and illumination models to guide intrinsic decomposition training.
